Today, Apple TV released the trailer for the fifth season of "Stillwater," the Peabody and Emmy Award-winning mindfulness series on the platform. Check it out below.

"Stillwater" returns on August 21

Just days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for the fifth season of "Stillwater," with all five episodes arriving on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of "Stillwater" will feature more "breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday habits," continuing the show's mission of helping children and families find inner peace.

"Stillwater" originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and has since won a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing in a Pre-School Animated Program, as well as a Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth Programming category.
